items.premise_verified: false for the brief's hypothesis, true for the rest. FALSE: the refused vegetable-oil/Sam's row is not a 35 lb jug sized from Sam's wrong unit price - out/sams/sams-deals-2026-09-21.json (rebuilt after e291a1) carries 'Member's Mark Canola Oil, 192 fl. oz.' at $7.16 with current_price, checkout price and Sam's own 3.7 cents/fl oz all agreeing on 192 fl oz, no density conflict, and no known-wrong ruling names it (0 of 23 findings). So it is a real refusal by a round floor, not a correct one, and the cell publishes QUARANTINED rather than clean. TRUE: the ratchet broke on exactly that one new cell (guards scoped it: 1 of 2,705), and origin/main:public/board.json @ aa53973d5 (committed 2026-09-21) shows the cell at 0.0723. Crown diff of the rebuilt board against that file, read before publishing: 36 crowns moved, 2 more than 25% cheaper (caraway-seeds -> Walmart 'Great Value Organic Caraway Seed, 1.8 oz' 2.4222; vanilla-extract -> Sam's 'Rising Star Baking Supply Pure Vanilla Extract, 8 fl. oz.' 1.1225), both the right product; 82 new cells, every name read.

That held run also sent one more 'GUARDS FAILED' page, absorbed into this item. (2) The first build refused itself ('ALL-3 VIOLATION: 1 priced chip(s) rendered without any link') because the held chip carried no link at all; it now carries the store search for the commodity, which vouches for no product's price. (3) The crown diff found one WRONG PRODUCT among the new cells: tomatoes | Fareway | 'Dei Fratelli Tomatoes, Whole' $2.68 / 28 oz - a CAN priced into Tomatoes (fresh) at 1.5314/lb. Ruled in known-wrong.json with add-known-wrong.ps1 and the chain re-run; the cell is now 'On The Vine Tomatoes' at 2.49/lb.

items.subject: A bad cell holds itself, not the board (Brad, 2026-09-21)
evidence: ad-cycle-log.txt since 2026-08-22, every 'guards: HARD FAIL' line classified under the new scoping: 2026-09-03, 09-06, 09-13 unit-basis-outlier; 09-07 band-censorship; 09-10 band-censorship + unit-basis-outlier; 09-14, 09-17 ad-line provenance + unit-basis-outlier; 09-18 08:13 ad-line + band-censorship + unit-basis-outlier; 09-18 14:53 capture-encoding + band-censorship; 09-19 16:36 band-censorship + food-category + unit-basis-outlier; 09-20 unit-basis-outlier + json-readers; 09-21 band-censorship. 12 hold runs: 11 carry only scoped classes (or the moved source ratchet), 1 (09-18 14:53, audit-capture-encoding) still holds.

CONSUMER CENSUS of guards.ps1's exit code, its GUARDS OK / GUARDS FAILED lines and its GUARDS-COMPLETE marker (code readers, not comments): (1) grocery/check-ad-cycles.ps1 morning ship path - read rc -ne 0 as blocked; (2) check-ad-cycles consistency auto-repair - published only on rc 0; (3) lib/chain-verdict-lib.ps1 Write-ChainVerdict - guards_blocked = rc -ne 0; (4) Read-ChainVerdictStatus - PASS/BLOCKED only, read by (5) grocery/capture-run.ps1 and (6) grocery/push-data.ps1 through ship_ok; (7) grocery/refresh-chain-verdict.ps1 - runs guards and writes the verdict; (8) grocery/capture-watchdog.ps1 and (9) grocery/health-heartbeat.ps1 - guards_blocked; (10) grocery/send-alert.ps1 Get-IncidentAbsorbTarget - guards_blocked; (11) check-ad-cycles Get-TestGuardsWeeklyPlan - defers test-guards on guards_rc -ne 0; (12) grocery/run-test-guards-weekly.ps1 and (13) grocery/test-guards.ps1 - baseline must be exit 0, each mutation must be exit 2 with its own HARD FAIL text; (14) grocery/weekly-post-capture.ps1 - 2 held, any other non-0 threw; (15) grocery/apply-coverage-batch.ps1 - reverts on non-0; (16) graph/learning/promote_aliases.py - refuses a non-0 baseline; (17) grocery/alert-registry.json + audit-alert-precision / alert-tuning - the 'grocery guards failed board not published' type; (18) grocery/triage-due.ps1 - RETURN lines by that type; (19) test-auditors.ps1 - source pins on guards.ps1. graph/agentic/plan.py and executor_selftest.py name the path only; .github/workflows/daily.yml is dispatch-only and does not run guards.

NEW CONTRACT: 0 GUARDS OK (clean); 2 not publishable AS IT STANDS - 'GUARDS FAILED' (hold) or 'GUARDS QUARANTINE-REQUIRED' (every failure scoped, under the breaker, out/cell-quarantine.json names the cells); 4 'GUARDS QUARANTINED' (applied and verified on this board: publishable). Exit 2 keeps its old meaning for every reader, so test-guards' 31 expect-2 mutation cases, weekly-post-capture, apply-coverage-batch and promote_aliases read a quarantine-required board exactly as before (not publishable as it stands). Readers of 4 were taught it: check-ad-cycles both paths publish on 0 or 4; the chain verdict records verdict=quarantine, guards_blocked=false, quarantined=N; Read-ChainVerdictStatus returns QUARANTINE with ship_ok (capture-run / push-data ship; watchdog, heartbeat and send-alert see not-blocked; the test-guards deferral reads 4 as not clean and defers); weekly-post-capture continues on 4. No reader reads 4 as 'all clean': the status word, the verdict word and the alert type all name it. A reader never taught 4 reads it as not-0, which holds - fail closed.

surface_fix.what: the mechanism, the three families and the breaker
surface_fix.exact_change: FAMILY 1 cell: guards 3, 4, 8, 10b by their own cell; 5 and 10 by the published cells carrying the failing capture row (none carries it: board scope, holds); delegated audits by QUARANTINE-CELL lines closed with QUARANTINE-SCOPE complete (taught: band-censorship, food-category, unit-basis-outlier). FAMILY 2 store: guards 6 and 9 by store; the applier withholds that store's EVERYDAY cells and keeps its live ad cells. FAMILY 3 board: everything else, unchanged. BREAKER: more than 2% of priced cells or more than 10% of one store's cells holds (integers). WHAT A CELL SHOWS (ruling A): its value on origin/main:public/board.json with that commit's date (carried through __rows q), or WITHHELD when there is none, it was a sale, it is past max_publish_age_days, or a VALUE guard condemned that same number; withholding a row's only priced cell refuses the apply (hold). The feed: export-feed skips pins and links on a held cell and is re-run after the apply. The page: the chip says 'as of <date>' and carries no See-item link; build-deals-page skips pins on a held cell. ALERT: 'Grocery: board cells quarantined - <date>' registered as page / condition 1, one page per distinct set; GUARDS FAILED reserved for a hold.

items.root_cause: the publish gate conflated three scopes of defect into one verdict, so its only available answer to one bad cell was to withhold every cell; the precision of the 'GUARDS FAILED' alert and the freshness of the whole board were both paying for it (15 of 30 alert days).

root_fix.what: the scope travels with each failure from the check that found it to the verdict, and teaching a guard to scope is a per-guard change with its own fixture, never a default: an unscoped failure holds
root_fix.exact_change: New-TcGuardFailure / ConvertTo-TcGuardFailures (an unscoped $fail entry is BOARD family) and Get-TcChildQuarantineScope (no 'complete' affirmation, no scope); the rule recorded in .claude/rules/grocery.md naming Brad's instruction and date

items.resolution_note: Per-cell quarantine shipped: a bad cell quarantines itself (held at its last verified published price with its date, or withheld), a bad store drops its everyday cells, and only a board-scoped failure or the 2% / 10% circuit breaker holds the board. guards exits 0 / 2 / 4; every reader of its verdict was censused and taught the new tier. audit-json-readers moved to run-gates.
items.premise_verified: true: every reader in the census was read at its call site before the contract was chosen; the three delegated audits behind 11 of the 12 holds since 2026-08-22 print per-cell findings that map to (id, store); the chain verdict's two ship readers (capture-run, push-data) key on ship_ok, so a QUARANTINE status that ships needed no change there; test-guards' mutation cases all expect 2, so keeping 2 for 'not publishable as it stands' left all of them valid. Proven live: check-ad-cycles -NoPull -NoCommit -NoPublish at 10:26 and 10:47 ran guards (QUARANTINE-REQUIRED, 1 of 2705), apply-cell-quarantine (held at 0.0723, last verified 2026-09-21), name-drift, guards again (GUARDS QUARANTINED, exit 4), export-feed, wrote chain-verdict {guards_rc 4, guards_blocked false, verdict quarantine, quarantined 1}, and paged once then 'quarantine set unchanged since the last page - not re-paging'.
items.deviation: Narrower than the spec in three places, each written into leaves_open or measured to zero. (a) FAMILY 2 was built at the post-guard seam (withhold the store's EVERYDAY cells, keep its live ad cells) instead of inside compare-deals' price-mode loader, because a store drop found by guards would need compare-deals re-run and the whole identity and link chain after it; the loader's price-mode drop is untouched and price-mode stays board scope. No store-scoped hold happened in the 30-day window (0 of 12 hold runs). (b) Of the delegated audits only band-censorship, food-category and unit-basis-outlier were taught to scope (they are 11 of the 12 holds); 8 others still hold (leaves_open, owner 2026-09-21-d16398). household-in-food, named in the spec, reads capture ROWS not board cells, so scoping it honestly needs the row-to-cell map guards 5 and 10 use - left with the other 7. (c) The censorship-ratchet exclusion was not built: 0 of 23 findings are proven wrong by another guard, so there was no case to build it from. ADDED beyond the spec: a VALUE finding on the second run against the HELD price holds (the last verified price is condemned too), and Invoke-GuardsGate re-derives name-drift after the apply (found live, see da5011).
